name: fz541_pressure_ally_switch
purpose: Spiritomb (Pressure) uses Ally Switch with Victreebel (step 2), then Hippowdon's Hyper Beam hits Victreebel on Spiritomb's old slot: the foe's PP that player 0 can attribute counts its own Pressure holder's extra by where it stands now (decision 0030 section 1), so its own-side timeline follows the SWAP (dfi_own_event). On main it charged the holder that had stood there before and the views differed from step 2 (issue 541). A battle of the differential fuzzing of issue 396 (free random sets, fz_159_24), whole. The choices and the seed are those of the campaign; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
